ConnectionStrings.//DefaultConnection: Never commit a real connection string. Production: set the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable on Render. Local: appsettings.Development.json.

Seo.//BaseUrl: Canonical origin, no trailing slash, e.g. https://myquickmenu.com. Leave empty to use the request host. Set this once a custom domain is live so canonicals never point at the onrender.com hostname.

Landing.//ContactUrl: Where the landing page's "Get in touch" buttons go for signed-out visitors (there is no self-serve signup). A mailto:, a contact form or a WhatsApp link. Empty = https://4cs.al/.
